drawCount.description: A fixed count, or the drawing player's own remaining Prize cards at resolution (「与自己剩余奖赏卡张数相同数量」); ifRemainingPrizes draws `then` instead of `otherwise` while exactly `equals` Prize cards remain (「如果自己的剩余奖赏卡张数为6张的话，则抽取的张数变为8张」).

oneOf.description: A count computed from the effect user's side when the effect starts, before any hand goes back (「数过自己的手牌之后…抽取与放回牌库的张数相同数量」, 「抽取与对手的手牌相同张数」, 「抽取4张。如果对手的剩余奖赏卡张数在3张及以下的话，则抽取的张数变为8张」); a negative result draws nothing.
「然后，抛掷1次硬币，如果为正面则从牌库上方抽取8张卡牌，如果为反面，则…抽取3张卡牌」: the drawing player flips 1 coin of its own when its draw is reached, after the hands went back (「双方玩家各抛掷1次硬币」: one coin each).

handDeckDraw.description: CN II.E-36 p74 then II.E-19 p62–63: whole hands into their own decks with a full-deck shuffle, then draws only if that actually happened.

optional.description: 「若希望，可让对手数其手牌，然后将所有手牌放回牌库并重洗牌库。在这种情况下，对手从牌库上方抽取与放回的张数相同数量的卡牌」 (II.E-10): the effect user decides first; a computed count is read before the decision, from the hands that would go back. Only as an entry of its own.

drawPokemonCount.description: Draw as many cards as the named side's in-play Pokémon at resolution (Active plus Bench).

countersValue.description: 「将与…数量相同数量的伤害指示物，放置于…」, 「将…张数×N个伤害指示物，放置于…」: a counter count the printed text computes from board, zone, Prize or history facts when they are placed; none when it is 0 or less. A count read for one Pokémon reads it as who target: all = 「给对手的所有宝可梦身上放置伤害指示物，直到其各自身上…变为原来的2倍为止」 (each Pokémon of the target its own count, all read before any is placed); countFrom = 「选择自己的1只备战宝可梦，将与被选择的宝可梦身上…相同的伤害指示物，放置于…」 (the user first chooses that Pokémon there).

drawValue.description: Draw a count the printed text computes from board, zone or history facts at resolution (「抽取与…数量相同数量的卡牌」, 「抽取2张。如果…的话，则额外抽取2张」); a negative result draws nothing.

cardsThenDraw.description: One printed card movement, then (II.E-19) a dependent draw for the effect user.

nestedEffect.description: A reviewed static core leaf composed by a control handler. Its own parameter validator still applies.

discardTools.description: Put Pokémon Tools attached to that side's Pokémon into their owner's discard pile (I.B-02; II.D-03 文例1 「将放于对手场上宝可梦身上的所有「宝可梦道具」，放于弃牌区」). target: whose Tools; selector: which Tools by printed identity; the effect user chooses; Pokémon protected from this effect offer none.

side.description: both: 「放于双方场上宝可梦身上的…「宝可梦道具」」, either player's Tools in one choice.

stadium.description: 「场上的…「宝可梦道具」或「竞技场」」「…以及放于场上的「竞技场」中的1张」: the Stadium in play (either player's, JP Q&A ザオボー) is one more card in the same choice (II.D-03; a Stadium protected from this effect is not offered).

specialEnergy.description: 「放于对手场上宝可梦身上的「宝可梦道具」「特殊能量」…中的1张」: the Special Energy cards attached to those Pokémon are more cards in the same choice, each to its owner's zone.

singleHolder.description: 「选择对手的1只宝可梦，将放于那只宝可梦身上的「宝可梦道具」和「特殊能量」各1张」 (quantity exact 1): all chosen cards on one Pokémon, one of each kind it holds (II.D-04: each kind its own number, only the kinds there).

to.description: lost: 「…放于放逐区」 instead of the discard pile; hand: 「…「宝可梦道具」，放回手牌」, its owner's hand (Tools only).

opponentHandLook.description: Before damage, look at the opponent's whole hand; the looked-at cards feed this attack's damage (「查看对手的手牌，造成其中训练家张数×N伤害」「如果其中有能量的话，则追加造成N伤害」; II.B-02, II.C-20).

countedCards.description: Before-damage discard of cards from the user's hand or deck, or a move of the user's hand or discard-pile cards to the Lost Zone, whose actual cards feed this attack's damage (「将自己手牌中任意数量的X放于弃牌区，造成其张数×N」「将自己牌库上方5张卡牌放于弃牌区，造成其中能量的张数×N」「将自己弃牌区中任意数量的X放于放逐区，追加造成其张数×N」; II.B-02).

optionalCounted.description: 「若希望，可将…放于弃牌区（／放回手牌／放回牌库）。在这种情况下，追加造成N伤害」「…追加造成其张数×N」 (II.E-10, II.B-02): before damage the user may decline; the cards actually moved (none when declined) feed this attack's damage. effect: the user's own attached Energy discarded or returned, Tools discarded, the user's hand/deck cards discarded, deck-top cards discarded (「若希望，可将自己牌库上方最多5张卡牌放于弃牌区」), Energy attached from the hand (「若希望，可以在造成伤害前，选择自己手牌中任意数量的…，附着于这只宝可梦身上」), or the Stadium in play discarded.

countedEnergyDiscard.description: Before-damage discard of attached Energy whose actual card count feeds this attack's damage (II.B-02, II.D-02 文例1), or the opponent's 「在造成伤害前，选择附着于对手战斗宝可梦身上的1个特殊能量，放于弃牌区」 (I.A-01 step 3). measure units (「…放于弃牌区，选择与其相同数量的…」): the record is the number of Energy units the discarded cards provided (of providedTypes when given). op moveEnergy (the user's own): 「将附着于自己备战宝可梦身上的任意数量的【雷】能量，转附于这只宝可梦身上，造成其张数×20」, the cards moved.

coin.description: II.C-05: flip once; only the printed result runs the effect, or several printed effects in order (「则A，并B」).

oneOf.description: 「抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则选择1种特殊状态，使对手的战斗宝可梦陷入该特殊状态」: the printed result leads to one choice (effects.choose-one).
「抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则将自己的所有手牌放回牌库并重洗牌库。然后，从牌库上方抽取6张卡牌」: one whole-hand pair with printed counts.
「抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则选择对手的1只备战宝可梦，将其与战斗宝可梦互换。然后，使新出场的宝可梦陷入【中毒】和【睡眠】状态」: the printed result is one 「A。然后，B」 (effects.coin-then).

otherwise.description: 「如果为正面则A，如果为反面则B」: what the other face does.

pokemon.description: effects.chosen-pokemon 「选择自己的1只宝可梦，抛掷1次硬币。如果为正面，则回复该宝可梦…如果为反面，则给该宝可梦…」: the user chooses this Pokémon first, then flips; each printed result (effect, otherwise: one leaf that can act on a bound Pokémon) acts only on it.

coins.description: Several flips, or flips until tails, then by how many show `face`: scale = the nested leaf is written for ONE such flip (「与出现正面次数相同数量」, 「出现正面次数×3张」) and the host multiplies its count; all = 「如果全部都是正面」; atLeast = 「如果出现2次以上正面」.

oneOf.description: 「抛掷与自己场上的「X」数量相同次数的硬币」: this many flips, read when the flips start (0 flips nothing).
「如果至少出现1次「正面」的话，则从「中毒、睡眠、混乱」中选择1个，…」: with all or atLeast, the printed result leads to one choice (effects.choose-one).

janken.description: 「与对手玩家猜拳，如果自己赢了，则…」 (effects.janken): both players choose a hand in secret, a tie is played again; only the user's win runs the printed effect (several in order: effects).

guess.description: 「选择自己手牌中的1张宝可梦，（将该宝可梦的名字／该宝可梦所拥有的招式名字告知对手后，）反面朝上放置。由对手回答该宝可梦的HP／名字／属性。将反面朝上的宝可梦翻到正面，如果正确的话，则对手从牌库上方抽取N张卡牌。如果不正确的话，则自己从牌库上方抽取N张卡牌。然后，将放置的卡牌放回自己手牌中。」 (effects.guess): hint = what the user tells first (name: its card name; attackNames: the names of its printed attacks; absent: nothing), question = what the opponent answers (hp, name, type), count = N.

coinReflip.description: 「（双方玩家，）在自己的回合有1次机会，因自己宝可梦的招式而抛掷硬币时，可无视这次抛掷硬币的所有结果，重新抛掷硬币」 (effects.coin-reflip): own = this card's owner (an Ability), all = both players (a Stadium); key = the once-per-turn use shared by every card naming it.

coinResult.description: An attack's later effect decided by the coins its own damage already flipped (II.E-38 文例3: 「抛掷3次硬币，造成正面次数×100点伤害。如果全部为反面，则…」). condition reads only coin facts of rolls this attack declares.

when.description: 「如果〈条件〉（的话），则A」, optionally 「如果不是，则B」 (otherwise): judged on the board when this instruction is reached. effects = several results of one condition, in order. The condition reads use-time facts only: no coin, counted-effect, Prizes-taken or damage-target read; a Trainer or Energy has no 「这只宝可梦」.

whenLeaf.description: A static leaf, or in an attack 「若这个招式的伤害将对手的宝可梦昏厥，则多获得1张奖赏卡。若额外附有7个能量，则改为多获得3张」 the extra Prize cards themselves (cn.extraPrizes@1).

optional.description: II.E-10: 「若希望，可……」 the user may decline the whole following effect (never a smaller printed quantity). 「若希望，可A。在这种情况下，B」: a cn.then@1 effect.

oneOf.description: 「若希望，可让对手将对手自己的所有手牌放回牌库并重洗牌库。在这种情况下，对手从牌库上方抽取4张卡牌」「若希望，可令对手重洗其牌库」.

consent.description: effects.consent 「选择自己弃牌区中的1张训练家，在给对手看过之后，询问对手是否可以加入手牌。如果对手允许，则将选择的卡牌加入手牌。如果对手不允许，则将选择的卡牌放回弃牌区，从自己的牌库上方抽取3张卡牌」: first (a shown discard-pile→hand move) is chosen and shown, then the OPPONENT allows or refuses it; otherwise runs only when refused. Usable only when first could be.

thenMoved.description: CN II.E-19 p62–63 with the cards A actually moved: 「将最多2张手牌放于弃牌区，抽取其张数×2张」 (use count: B's count, written for one such card, times the cards moved), 「将牌库上方3张卡牌放于弃牌区，将其中所有能量，附着于这只宝可梦身上」 (use cards: B takes only those cards), 「选择…1张【水】宝可梦，放于备战区。然后，…附着于该宝可梦身上」 (use pokemon: B acts only on the Pokémon A put into play, attached Energy to, moved Energy to or healed; after a switch, the Pokémon it moved to the Bench). B runs only if A moved at least one card (affected a Pokémon).

counted.description: Instead of first, 「然后，将放于弃牌区的能量附着于这只宝可梦身上」: the cards this attack's own counted before-damage entry (this effectId) put into its user's discard pile.

oneOf.description: 「如果那张卡牌是宝可梦…的话，则选择那只宝可梦所拥有的1个招式，作为这个招式使用」: a copy among the moved cards only (use cards; its own validator applies).

use.description: none: 「当成功把卡牌放于备战区时，…」 — B only needs A to have moved at least one card and is not bound to them.

optional.description: 「若希望，可将该宝可梦…」「…时，若希望，可…」: with use pokemon or none, the user may decline the next part.

condition.description: 「如果追加附有1个能量的话，则给新出场的宝可梦身上…」: B runs only if this holds when B is reached (the facts cn.when@1 reads).

ifMoved.description: 「如果被放于弃牌区的卡牌是能量的话，则再抽取2张卡牌」: after B, effect (not bound) runs only if a card A moved is of this kind, wherever it ended up.

then.description: CN II.E-19 p62–63: 「A。然后，B」 or 「如果成功执行A了的话，则B」: B runs only if A was at least partly performed.

oneOf.description: 「然后，使新出场的宝可梦陷入【中毒】和【睡眠】状态」: B is several printed steps, run in order.
「…。然后，抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则…」: B is one coin; 「…。然后，从2个效果中选择1个效果使用」: B is one choice (its own validator applies).

discardDeckTop.description: Put the top cards of the named side's deck into its owner's discard pile (II.C-01; II.A: as many as the deck holds).

to.description: 「将对手牌库上方的N张卡牌，放于放逐区」: into the deck holder's Lost Zone instead.

from.description: 「将自己牌库下方N张卡牌放于弃牌区」: the bottom cards instead of the top ones.

upTo.description: 「将自己牌库上方最多N张卡牌放于弃牌区」: the user first picks how many, 1 to N (II.D-05), as many as the deck holds.

attachThenDraw.description: One effect attachment from hand or discard, then (II.E-19) a dependent draw for the effect user.

countedFieldReturn.description: damage.bench-count: an attack's own Benched Pokémon leaving before damage, the number of Pokémon recorded for its formula; quantity may be 「最多与对手场上宝可梦数量相同数量的…」 (upTo a battle value).

energyOptions.description: An alternative cost of this attack; condition: 「这个招式，如果……的话，则仅需……便可使用」, judged when the attack could be declared.

countedSwitch.description: 「选择对手的1只备战宝可梦，将其与战斗宝可梦互换。然后，给新出场的宝可梦造成N伤害」: the switch runs before damage and records the Pokémon that came in (none when nothing was switched), so the attack's damage formula can require it.

switch.description: CN C-03—05: explicitly identify the switched side, choosing player relative to the source, and affected Active or selected Bench Pokémon.

affected.description: source: this effect's own Benched Pokémon becomes the Active Pokémon (「将这只宝可梦与战斗宝可梦互换」).

selector.description: Only Benched Pokémon matching this may come in (「与备战区中的【雷】宝可梦互换」「选择对手备战区中的1只【基础】宝可梦」).

activeSelector.description: 「将自己战斗场上的【基础】宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换」: only while the Active Pokémon matches this (current stage and types).

outgoingHeal.description: 「然后，回复被换入备战区的宝可梦「N」点HP」: the Pokémon that actually moved from the Active Spot to the Bench, after the switch.

bottom.description: 「从自己的牌库下方抽取N张卡牌」: drawn one by one from the deck bottom.

upTo.description: 「从自己牌库上方抽取最多N张卡牌」 (II.D-05): one card at a time, 1 to N; after each card its drawer may stop (cn.draw@1 only, not drawUntil).

opponentMayDraw.description: 「对手若希望，可从牌库上方抽取N张卡牌」 (count N), 「…。在这种情况下，自己额外从牌库上方抽取M张卡牌」 (ownDraw M): the opponent decides (II.E-10); the user's draw follows only when the opponent drew.

drawPlayers.description: 「双方玩家，各从牌库上方抽取N张卡牌」 (own N, opponent N) or 「对手从牌库上方抽取N张卡牌」 (own 0): the effect user draws first, then the opponent; a player with too few cards draws what there is (II.A).

until.description: 「双方玩家各从牌库上方抽取卡牌，直到手牌变为N张为止」: own and opponent are the hand sizes each draws up to (from the hand when that draw begins).

upTo.description: 「各从牌库上方抽取最多N张卡牌」: each drawing player draws 1 to its count, one card at a time, and may stop after each (II.D-05).

optional.description: 「双方玩家，若希望，可各…抽取」: each player decides for its own draw (the user first) whether to draw at all (II.E-10).

reveal.description: 「各从自己牌库上方抽取2张卡牌，互相展示过正面后加入手牌」: each drawn card is shown to both players before it joins the hand.

discardHand.description: 「将自己的手牌全部放于弃牌区」 ({}); side opponent = 「将对手的手牌全部放于弃牌区」: every card of the opponent's hand.

damageRedirect.description: 「（当…时，）若希望，可将这个招式的伤害，给予对手的1只备战宝可梦而不是战斗宝可梦」 (damage.redirect; attacks only, before damage): the user may choose one of the opponent's Benched Pokémon; this attack's damage then goes to it instead of the Active Pokémon, as damage to a Benched Pokémon. condition = the printed 「当…时」, judged when the choice is offered.

setupPlacement.description: setup.placement, a Pokémon's own printed rule: 「在对战准备中要将宝可梦放于战斗场时，如果这张卡牌在手牌中的话，则可反面朝上放于战斗场上」 (position active) / 「如果自己是后攻玩家，则在对战准备中将宝可梦放于场上时，可将这张卡牌从手牌以反面朝上的状态放于场上」 (position field, secondPlayer): in setup this card may be put face down onto the Active Spot (and, for field, the Bench) like a Basic Pokémon; a hand with no Basic Pokémon but such a card may still be redrawn.

enterOnlyBy.description: 「这张卡牌，只有通过「海豚侠」的特性「全能变身」的效果才能被放于场上」: only that Ability of a card with one of these name keys may put this card into play (setup, the hand and every other effect are closed).

ifKnockedOut.description: 「如果因为这个招式对手的宝可梦【昏厥】的话，则当这个回合结束时，自己的回合会再开始1次」 (attacks only): only if this attack (its damage or effects) Knocked Out an opponent's Pokémon this turn.

side.description: event (with target event): 「给双方所有…宝可梦」 in a per-Pokémon trigger, the event Pokémon of either player.

targets.description: 「给对手的2只备战宝可梦身上，各放置1个伤害指示物」: distinct Pokémon, each receiving count.

all.description: 「给对手所有的（…）宝可梦身上，各放置N个」: every matching Pokémon, no choice.

countersFromDamage.description: 「当这只宝可梦受到招式的伤害时，将与受到的伤害数值相同的伤害指示物，放置于使用了招式的宝可梦身上」: in an attack-damage reaction, damage ÷ 10 counters (the damage after Weakness and Resistance).

countersUntil.description: 「在对手（战斗）宝可梦身上放置伤害指示物，直到其剩余HP变为「N」（点）（为止）」: the number of counters is (remaining HP − N) ÷ 10, the remaining HP (II.D-16) read when they are placed; none when it is already N or less (II.C-07).

all.description: 「给对手所有的备战宝可梦身上放置伤害指示物，直到其剩余HP均变为「N」为止」: every Pokémon of the target (any/bench), each to its own N, no choice.

stadiumUse.description: A Stadium effect a player may declare 「每次在自己的回合有1次机会」 (I.B-04): once per player per turn under this card's own key; the effect is a reviewed static leaf or one cn.then@1 (「可A。在这种情况下，B」), a whole-hand pair with printed counts (「可将自己的手牌全部放回牌库并重洗牌库。在这种情况下，可从自己的牌库上方抽取5张卡牌」), one coin (「可抛掷1次硬币。如果为正面，则…」) or one condition on the using player (「在这个回合，从手牌使出了支援者的玩家，可…」). endsTurn: 「在这种情况下，自己的回合结束」 after it resolves (II.E-20 文例3).

oneOf.description: 「可选择…放于那只宝可梦身上进行进化。如果进化了的话，则可以继续选择1张【2阶进化】宝可梦，使其进化」: one bound pair (its own validator applies).

countedReveal.description: Before damage, cards turned face up or shown to the opponent are recorded for this attack's formula; they stay where they are (II.B-02). deck: 「将自己牌库上方N张卡牌翻到正面」, all N recorded (count a kind with movedCards). discard: 「将自己弃牌区中的所有X给对手查看」, every matching card. hand: 「将自己手牌中任意数量的X给对手查看」, the cards the user shows. bothHands: 「双方互相展示手牌」, every card of both hands (read with movedCards sharedName).

revealedCards.description: After damage, the cards an earlier cn.countedReveal@1 of the same attack (effectId) recorded go on: to (deck = into the deck, then shuffle). With selector only the matching ones go to `to`; the others go to rest (a deck-top reveal only: 「将正面朝上的X放于弃牌区，剩余的卡牌放回牌库并重洗牌库」). Cards no longer in their zone are skipped.

countedDeckTop.description: Before damage, 「（双方各）将牌库上方N张卡牌放于弃牌区，追加造成其中能量张数×N」: the discarded cards are recorded for this attack's formula; both = the user's deck first, then the opponent's. upTo: 「将自己牌库上方最多N张卡牌放于弃牌区」, the user first picks how many (1 to N, II.D-05). leave (own deck, no count): 「将自己的牌库从上方开始放于弃牌区直到剩余张数变为N张为止」, all but the bottom N at once.

countedPrizes.description: Before damage, 「将自己的1张反面朝上的奖赏卡翻为正面。如果该卡牌是【火】能量的话，则追加造成50点伤害」: the user's own face-down Prize(s) turned face up (prizes.face-up), recorded for this attack's formula (movedCards / effectCards); none face down, nothing is flipped.

countedSelfCounters.description: Before damage, 「给这只宝可梦身上放置最多N个伤害指示物，造成放置的伤害指示物数量×M伤害」: the user picks 0 to N; the number placed is recorded for this attack's formula (effectCards).

countedCounters.description: Before damage, 「在对手战斗宝可梦身上放置伤害指示物，直到其剩余HP变为「10」为止。然后，给这只宝可梦造成120伤害」: counters on one Pokémon (cn.counters@1 or cn.countersUntil@1 parameters, without all/targets); the number placed is recorded for this attack's later damage (effectCards, 0 when none).

countValue.description: A printed count computed when the effect resolves (「与…数量相同数量」「…张数×N个」「最多与…相同张数」): effect is written for a count of 1 (count 1, quantity exact/upTo 1, or a heal of 10 = one damage counter removed) and the host puts the value there; nothing happens at 0 or less, except that a printed look at the opponent's hand (「查看对手的手牌，选择其中最多与…相同数量的…」) still happens.

next.description: 「将与对手弃牌区中的宝可梦张数相同数量的伤害指示物，以任意方式放置于…。然后，将对手弃牌区中的宝可梦，全部放回…」 (II.E-19): a static leaf run only if the counted part was performed; the count is read before anything else of this entry.

deployIncomingThen.description: 「将这只宝可梦放于自己的备战区。然后，…」 in a beforeHand Ability: next (a static leaf, or one cn.coin@1) only once this card was placed (II.E-19).

ifPaid.description: 「在这种情况下，…」 after an Item/Supporter's optional play cost (effects.optional-cost): effect (or effects, in order) only when the cost was paid. otherwise: only the 「将自己的战斗宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。…在这种情况下，回复被换到备战区的宝可梦「N」点HP」 form — effect is a cn.switch@1 with outgoingHeal and otherwise the same switch without it — and the 「…放于该宝可梦身上进行进化。…在这种情况下，将…附着于进化后的宝可梦身上」 form — effect is a cn.thenMoved@1 and otherwise its first part alone.

gameResult.description: II.E-38 「这场对战（算作）自己的胜利」 (win) / 「这场对战己方败北」 (lose): the game ends here with that result, outside the I.E checks.

turnEndEffect.description: II.E-20 「使用了这张卡牌的回合结束时，（如果〈条件〉的话，则）…」 on an Item/Supporter: recorded when the card is used, performed when this turn ends (after the attack, or ending the turn without one) and before the checkup; condition is judged then.

on.description: A Tool's 「当身上放有这张卡牌的宝可梦使用招式时，因招式的伤害或效果自己抛掷硬币而出现反面的话，则在自己的回合结束时，…」: recorded (once a turn for this card) when its holder's attack makes its player flip tails, not when a card is played.

returnSelf.description: 「不将这张「X」放于弃牌区，而是放回手牌」 (default) / 「…而是放回牌库并重洗牌库」 (to deckShuffle): the Item/Supporter in use.

deploySelf.description: 「将这张卡牌放于备战区。（然后，…）」 in an Ability used from hand or discard (zone): this card onto its owner's Bench; next (a static leaf, or one cn.coin@1) only once it was placed (II.E-19), with 「这只宝可梦」 = the Pokémon it became. to: 「将这张卡牌放回牌库下方／放于放逐区（。然后，…）」 — the card goes there instead, never into play (next has no 「这只宝可梦」).

to.description: deckBottom/lost: 「将这张卡牌放回牌库下方／放于放逐区」, never into play. active: 「将这张卡牌直接从手牌使出放于战斗场。在这种情况下，将战斗宝可梦放回备战区」: onto the Active Spot instead, the Active Pokémon moving to the Bench (it needs a Bench space).

attachSelf.description: pokemon.attached-card: a Pokémon card's own activated Ability puts the card itself onto one of its owner's Pokémon as another kind of card, which it is while it stays attached there (anywhere else it is the Pokémon card). specialEnergy 「如果这张卡牌在手牌中的话，…将这张卡牌作为特殊能量附着于自己的「X」身上。只要这张卡牌，被附着于宝可梦身上就可被视作2个【雷】能量」 (a hand Ability): from the hand onto one recipient, attached from the hand as a Special Energy card providing units. tool 「将放于这只宝可梦身上的卡牌全部放于弃牌区，将这只宝可梦作为「宝可梦道具」，放于自己的宝可梦身上。当放有这张卡牌的宝可梦【昏厥】时，…」 (an in-play Ability): every other card of this Pokémon is discarded, it leaves play and goes onto another of its owner's Pokémon with room for a Tool, a Pokémon Tool card whose effects are effects (about its holder).

recipient.description: 「自己的「锹农炮虫（包含GX）」」: only Pokémon of this kind (current types) receive it.

units.description: 「被视作2个【雷】能量」: the Energy it provides as a Special Energy card, as a printed Special Energy's baseUnits.

effects.description: 「当放有这张卡牌的宝可梦【昏厥】时，对手拿取的奖赏卡将减少1张」: its effects as a Tool, each in its handler's own parameters (scope self: its holder).

revealHands.description: 「双方玩家，各将自己的手牌翻到正面，互相展示」: both hands are shown to both players; nothing moves.

evolutionPermission.description: This Pokémon's own evolution permission (effects.program evolutionPermission without op/scope).

healBefore.description: 「在进化前，将这只宝可梦的HP，全部回复」: when it evolves from the hand by the fromName permission, it is fully healed first.

chooseOne.description: 「这张卡牌，可以从2个效果中选择1个使用。◆A ◆B」「选择1种特殊状态，使…陷入该特殊状态」「选择自己或对手，被选择的玩家…」 (II.A, II.D-04): the effect user chooses one printed option that could change something now (effects.choose-one). An option is one entry or the entries of one ◆ in order.

chooser.description: 「对手将…。或者，对手选择…」: the effect user's opponent picks the option (effects.choose-one-opponent); absent = the effect user.

knockOut.description: 「令这只宝可梦／对手的战斗宝可梦／使用了招式的宝可梦【昏厥】」, 「选择对手备战区中的N只…宝可梦，令其【昏厥】」 (I.D): Knocked Out at the end of the effect, regardless of HP. self = this Pokémon (no side); otherwise side + active/attacker, or bench/any with count = the user chooses that many of the matching Pokémon (selector, state).

side.description: both = 「从双方场上所有宝可梦中」 (target any).

excludeSelf.description: 「除这只宝可梦外」: never this Pokémon (target any).

lowestRemainingHp.description: 「选择1只剩余HP最少的宝可梦」 (II.D-16, effects.knockout-lowest): only the matching Pokémon with the least remaining HP; the user picks one of a tie (target any, count 1).

cure.description: 「恢复（这只宝可梦／自己的战斗宝可梦／对手的战斗宝可梦）的所有特殊状态」: every listed Special Condition it has is recovered (conditions absent = all five; 「恢复【中毒】状态」 = ['poisoned']). count = 「恢复N个特殊状态」: the user chooses N of the listed ones it has (all when it has no more).

cureAll.description: 「回复…HP，并恢复其全部特殊状态」: the same Pokémon also recovers from every Special Condition it has; it may then be chosen when it has one, even undamaged.

targetSelector.description: 「回复自己1只【草】宝可梦…」: only a Pokémon of this kind (current types) may be chosen.

side.description: event (with target active or event): in a trigger, the event Pokémon's owner, whichever player.

inherit.description: 「新出场的宝可梦，会继承其【中毒】状态。（如果因该【中毒】而放置的伤害指示物数量有所增加的话，则也同样继承其数量。）」 (status.inherit): the Poison the event Pokémon had at the event, with its own counter count.

sleepCoins.description: 「因这个【睡眠】而抛掷的硬币次数变为2次，只要不是全为正面就不会恢复」 (asleep only).

confusionCounters.description: 「因这个【混乱】而放置的伤害指示物数量变为6个」 (confused only).

stages.description: Printed stage of each affected Pokémon, e.g. 「身上放有这张卡牌的【基础】宝可梦」「所有【2阶进化】宝可梦」.

perEnergyType.description: hp only: amount × the Energy units attached to the affected Pokémon that can provide this type now (「这只宝可梦身上每附有1个【钢】能量，这只宝可梦的最大HP就会增加「20」点」).

targetRetreatCost.description: 「身上放有这张卡牌的【撤退】所需能量为4个的宝可梦」: only while the affected Pokémon's current Retreat Cost is exactly this many Energy (never on a retreat modifier).

condition.description: 「如果追加附有3个【火】能量的话，…。在这种情况下，这个招式的伤害不计算…」: the flags apply only while this holds when the damage is calculated (attack facts such as extraEnergy).

ifDamageKnockedOut.description: 「如果因这个招式的伤害，对手的宝可梦【昏厥】的话，则在下一个对手的回合，…」 (attacks only): the effect is in force only once this attack's damage has Knocked Out an opponent's Pokémon (not counters from its effects, not a Pokémon that stayed in play).

clearOnLeaveActive.description: 「这个效果，一直持续到这只「X」离开战斗场」: the effect on the affected Pokémon also ends for good once the effect's user, in the Active Spot when it began, leaves the Active Spot (effects.duration.user-leaves-active).

allOf.description: ability.granted 「这只宝可梦，在离开场上之前都拥有效果为「…」的特性」: the user itself, until it leaves play.

oneOf.description: repeat (II.D-02 文例; attack.order): 「选择N次对手的宝可梦…（同1只宝可梦可以选择多次）」 N 2–10, or a count the attack reads when the picks start (「选择与其相同数量的对手的宝可梦」, e.g. effectCards of its counted discard); none at 0 or less.
「选择与放于弃牌区数量相同数量的对手宝可梦」: that many different Pokémon, a count the attack reads when its damage step starts (e.g. effectCards of its counted departure); none at 0 or less.

chooser.description: 「对手选择对手自己的1只宝可梦。给该宝可梦造成N点伤害」 (attack.opponent-target): the opponent chooses which of their own Pokémon takes it (one, a Pokémon protected from it included); side opponent, an exact number.

printed.description: attack.printed-target 「给对手的1只宝可梦，造成…伤害」 with a printed damage (「20×」): this packet is the attack's own printed damage, dealt to the one chosen Pokémon instead of the opponent's Active; the attack has no other damage formula.

useCoin.description: effects.use-coin 「只要这只宝可梦在战斗场上，当对手从手牌将能量附着于宝可梦身上时，在附着能量之前对手抛掷1次硬币…」 (a Pokémon's continuous Ability).

extraPrizes.description: 「如果因为这个招式的伤害，对手的（【基础】）宝可梦【昏厥】的话，则多拿取N张奖赏卡」 (attacks only).

allOf.description: effects.player-ability-removal 「在这个回合结束前，对手战斗宝可梦的特性，全部消除」: this turn only, never ending with its user.
effects.coin-choice 「在这个回合，使用了这张卡牌后，首次…其第一次的结果，可由自己决定」: this turn only.
effects.coin-face 「在下一个对手的回合，将对手抛掷的硬币的结果，全部视作反面」: the opponent, in that turn only.
effects.use-coin 「在下一个对手的回合，每当对手从手牌使出训练家时，在使用前抛掷1次硬币…」: the opponent, in that turn.

quantity.description: upTo 「最多N个」; all 「（放置的）全部／所有伤害指示物」 (no count); any 「任意数量的伤害指示物，（以任意方式）转放于…」: one counter at a time, from any origin, each to a destination the player chooses, until they stop (with count: 「选择放置于自己场上宝可梦身上的最多N个伤害指示物」, at most N in all).

originSelector.description: 「选择自己备战区中的1只「古代」宝可梦」: the origin's printed kind.

originSide.description: 「对手场上（1只）宝可梦身上放置的…」 / 「双方场上宝可梦身上放置的…」; absent = the user's own Pokémon.

targetSelector.description: 「转放于自己其他【超】宝可梦身上」: the destination's kind.

each.description: 「自己所有宝可梦身上放置的伤害指示物各N个」 (from every): each origin gives N counters (all it has, if fewer).

split.description: 「以任意方式转放于…」: each moved counter goes to a destination the player chooses.

type.description: The named Basic Energy type, or null for any Basic Energy card.

types.description: 「【超】或【钢】能量」: a Basic Energy card of any of these types; type is then null.

category.description: 「能量」 (any Energy card, II.C-09) or 「特殊能量」; absent = Basic Energy only. With a category, type is null. A Special Energy attached to a Pokémon it cannot be attached to is discarded (II.C-10 FAQ2).

target.description: Attach only to this effect's own Pokémon (「附着于这只宝可梦身上」), or to the user's Active Pokémon (「附着于战斗宝可梦身上」).

exact.description: 「选择…中的N张…，附着于」 without 「最多」: exactly N, or all there are if fewer (II.D-04); absent = 1 to N.

anyNumber.description: 「任意数量的…能量」 (II.D-02): any number, none included; count is then 60, the whole deck.

recipient.description: Printed in-play predicate of each recipient, e.g. a 「古代」 tag.

distribution.description: singleRecipient: all chosen cards go to one Pokémon (「附着于1只…身上」). separateRecipients: each Pokémon receives at most one (「各附着1张」). perRecipient: count is per recipient (「各附着2张」): up to count × the recipients are chosen (exact: that many, or all there are), each recipient receiving at most count of them. Absent: each card chooses freely.

spareKnockOut.description: 「（对会被【昏厥】的宝可梦，无法使用这个特性。）」: no recipient whose remaining HP (II.D-16) the recipient counters would use up.

nameKeys.description: 「选择自己手牌中的1张「治疗能量」」: only Energy cards of these names (with the category the card is printed in).

side.description: 「选择对手弃牌区中最多3张能量，以任意方式附着于对手的宝可梦身上」: the opponent's discard pile onto the opponent's Pokémon, the effect user choosing (cn.attachDiscard@1 only).
